summary: Madison County, MT 40-foot pole tower raised in 1952 on private co-op land; listed as gone, and no source describes the site today.

access.note: Listed as a private co-op site; the Forest Lookouts page gives the cooperator as private. No public access described.

events.note: 40-foot pole tower, per the firelookout.com listing
The listing gives 1957 with a question mark after it

evidence.supports: located a quarter mile east of the ridgetop

notes_for_editor: Location is unresolved: the record uses the FFLA point (45.2646, -111.40617); firelookout.com and west_us_lookouts put it about 1.6 km northeast (see record conflicts). Left the record location alone. Elevation of 8,500 ft (about 2,591 m) could fill elevation_m. Record ownership is 'unknown'; sources say private cooperator, shown only in facts.access. The 1957 abandonment year carries a question mark in the source. The 'Removed' marker on the Forest Lookouts page is undated, so it is in the story but not in events. No staffing source found. Used one WebSearch; it added nothing new about the site. Fact-check 2026-10-10: added the Madison County quote from firelookout.com and reworded the sentence that said the land is private, since the listings name the site or the cooperator as private.
